name: Global.Console
description:
The toplevel `console` support is intended to supplement [Titanium.API](api:Titanium.API)
and make it easier for developers to port existing javascript code
(especially CommonJS modules) to Titanium.

Note that `console` does not currently implement the complete
[Console](https://developer.mozilla.org/de/docs/Web/API/Console) specification.
See the following supported methods for details and submit a pull request to add more!

methods.name: assert
methods.summary: A simple assertion test that verifies whether value is truthy. If it is not, Assertion failed is logged. If provided, the error message is formatted using `util.format()` by passing along all message arguments. The output is used as the error message.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: The value tested for being truthy.

parameters.name: message
parameters.summary: All arguments besides value are used as error message.

methods.name: count
methods.summary: Maintains an internal counter specific to `label` and outputs to stdout the number of times `console.count()` has been called with the given `label`.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: The display label for the counter

methods.name: countReset
methods.summary: Resets the internal counter specific to `label`.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: The display label for the counter

methods.name: debug
methods.summary: Log a message at the `debug` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.

methods.name: error
methods.summary: Log a message at the `error` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.

methods.name: group
methods.summary: Increases indentation of subsequent lines by spaces for `groupIndentation` length.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: Labels to print before indentation (if provided)

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: Labels to print before indentation (if provided)

methods.name: groupEnd
methods.summary: Decreases indentation of subsequent lines by spaces for `groupIndentation` length.

methods.name: info
methods.summary: Log a message at the `info` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.

methods.name: log
methods.summary: Log a message at the `info` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.

Note that this method has different behavior from [Titanium.API.log](api:Titanium.API#log),
which can take multiple arguments, but in doing so interprets the
first argument as a custom log level.

methods.name: time
methods.summary: Start a timer to track duration of an operation.
methods.description:
Begin a timer that can be used to track the duration of an operation.
If no label is passed to the function it will default to "default".
If a label already exists then the existing label will not be overwritten
and a warning will be logged to the console.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: The label to track the timer by

methods.name: timeEnd
methods.summary: Stop a timer that was previously started.
methods.description:
Stop a timer that was started by calling [console.time](api:Global.Console#time), and
output the time since the timer was begun to the console in milliseconds.
If no timer exists a warning will be logged to the console.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: The label to track the timer by

methods.name: timeLog
methods.summary: Log duration taken so far for an operation.
methods.description:
Output the time since a timer was started by calling
[console.time](api:Global.Console#time) to the console, as well as any
other `data` arguments provided. To log extra data a label must
be provided. If no timer exists a warning will be logged to the
console.

parameters.name: label
parameters.summary: The label to track the timer by

parameters.name: data
parameters.summary: Extra log data to be provided when logging, can be a single argument or any number of arguments.

methods.name: trace
methods.summary: Log a message at the `trace` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.

methods.name: warn
methods.summary: Log a message at the `warn` level.
methods.description:
The message to log can either be a single argument, or any number
of arguments, which will be converted to strings and then concatenated
together with a space character.
